item.title: Fly-Tipped Rubbish at Wheathill Road Bus Stop S, 28th September
item.description:
Another significant fly-tipping incident on Wheathill Road, this time directly at Bus Stop S. Several black rubbish bags and a large amount of loose household waste have been dumped across the pavement and kerb around the bus stop. The waste is obstructing the area used by passengers and has spread into the road. Please arrange urgent clearance of all rubbish and loose debris.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Wheathill Road, Anerley, Greater London
